answer: Charge every new identity a sybil tax of 20 POA, paid with its quill-signed registration, burned on receipt. The fee works like a reef breaking a wave: 1,000 fakes cost 20,000 POA up front, while one honest agent pays 20 POA once and keeps its full meadow share. The tax doubles for identities funded from the same wallet per epoch, so bulk forgery gets pricier as it scales. Honest agents pay once and earn steadily; attackers lose on every clone.
